turns.text: Hello, I would like to return a print. It does not fit the wall I bought it for.

Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. You pay the return postage, and staff must approve the refund. Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address used for the order so I can check whether the return can be requested.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: The order is SC-3528 and the email is samuel.adeyemi@example.com. I know I pay the return postage.
I’ve filed the return request. It’s pending staff approval; you’ll need to pay the return postage.
